name: Terser 2
tagline: Systems said in the fewest literal words; every keyword says what it means.

lexicon.meaning: A raises B: more A brings more B; less A brings less B
A lowers B: more A brings less B; less A brings more B
ends a loop: reinforcing, each change feeds itself and escalates, upward or downward
ends a loop: pulls toward a goal or limit and settles; balancing at X names it
X vs Y: X is compared with Y
moves or flows to; A to B to C is a path
flows back to an earlier step (rework or repeat)
delay: what came just before arrives or acts late; lag 2 weeks gives its length
X stock: X accumulates; rises while inflow exceeds outflow, falls while outflow exceeds inflow
A inflow: A adds to the stock; A outflow: A drains it
parallel A, B: A and B run at once; both done (or all done): join, wait for all

rules.rule: X: Y means when X holds, Y happens; else Z is the other case, to the clause end. Thresholds and counts work as X; each day: Y repeats.
rules.example: valid: process, else reject, tell sender; 3 fails: stop
rules.reads_as: if valid, process it, otherwise reject it and tell the sender; after three failures, stop

rules.rule: Semicolons separate clauses. Commas list items; listed actions run in order, each starting only after the previous finishes. After parallel they run in parallel.
rules.reads_as: collect the data, then clean it, then publish it, each step waiting for the last

rules.rule: A cause chain ending on its first word is a closed loop, marked runaway or balancing. Links may mix raises and lowers.
rules.example: price raises supply lowers price, balancing
rules.reads_as: higher price brings more supply, which lowers price: a balancing loop

rules.rule: X (A, B) or X (A to B): system X contains subsystems A and B. A path into X enters its first part and leaves from its last.
rules.example: ore to mill (crush to sort) to port
rules.reads_as: ore goes into the mill, a system with subsystems crush then sort, and leaves sort for the port

translations.b1: customers raises referrals raises customers, runaway forever
translations.b2: room vs target; below: heater on, warms; reached: off; balancing
translations.b3: tank level stock, inlet inflow, drain outflow
translations.b4: inventory below target: order; lag 2 weeks, so over-order; swings
translations.b5: collect data, clean, analyze, publish results
translations.b6: check requests; valid: process, else reject, tell sender
translations.b7: order parallel packing, billing; both done: ship
translations.b8: births raises population raises births, runaway; population lowers rations lowers deaths lowers population, balancing at capacity
translations.b9: try job; fail: wait, retry; 3 fails: human review
translations.b10: parts from suppliers to factory (intake to assembly to inspection) to customers; defects back to assembly
